notes.title: CAPES, POTIONS AND ABILITY UPGRADES (1.34.0)
notes.content:
Hey all! Sorry for the delay with this update, been working on my next game ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3452770/CATACOMB/]check it out here[/url]).

This is a huge update though and I'm super excited to release it.

[h1]Capes are back![/h1]
Capes haven't been in the game for a while, but finally they're back
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/c65b39a523ae670584322ed283587ab2866a9412.png[/img]
I've designed loads of awesome capes, including bringing back the super exclusive top 100 cape for the top 100 worldwide Paint Warfare players :)

This is probably the rarest item in the game, and in general I want capes to be rare.

[h1]Potions[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/37e1c0deccd3dd6718033842218526a1309082aa.png[/img]
Introducing potions! Potions give you a special boost for a life and you can buy them in bundles of 10. For now theres's 3 potions in the game:
[list]
[*][b]Anti-gravity potion:[/b] - this one's mostly for fun, it makes you jump super high and feel like you're in space
[*][b]Regeneration potion:[/b] - gives you a slight health regeneration boost
[*][b]XP potion:[/b] - doubles your XP, stacks with the supporter double XP boost
[/list]

[h1]Ability Upgrades[/h1]
You can now upgrade most abilities to level 6 or 10 now. Upgrades include increasing the duration of the invisibility boost, dashing further, or making the grapple hook pull you more!
Each upgrade is just a slight buff for now (but this may change in the future).

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Nerfed the rocket launcher. Its reload speed is now double as long (5s instead of 2.5)
[/olist]

[h1]Polish and bug fix[/h1]
[list]
[*]Decreased game size to under 1GB
[*]Fixed bugs with maps
[*]Added a pop up advertising my upcoming game
[*]Changed the russian and english tutorial voice over to reflect auto sprint being on by default
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the UI for active invisibility/ half shield ability to not be visisble
[*]Fixed a bug that caused purchasing weapon skins to fail sometimes
[*]UI improvements
[*]Fixed a pricing issue with coins, basically the casket of coins is a better deal now
[*]You now get 25% more coins than before on sack, casket and chest of coins
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the under water area to be broken in the tutorial level
[/list]

notes.title: NEW MOVEMENT, NEW GAMEMODE & NEW MAP (1.32.0)
notes.content:
Heya

[h1]New Map: Palace![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/a5e739b810a85fe15ddc0c6298a0bb61e4892700.png[/img]

Introducing palace—a map set in the ruins of a billionaire's mansion.

[h2]New Gamemode: King Of the Hill[/h2]
[list]
[*]Palace is the first map to be king of the hill
[*]It's basically FFA BUT
[*]There's a hot zone that gives you crazy amounts of points, and it changes location ever 45 seconds
[/list]

[h1]Dunes Reworks[/h1]
I've finally overhauled the OG map
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/c78e8a646f73c816469d46b4cd715683eeb84415.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/94e1e647836668a9e8820f4cd4822296643ac786.png[/img]

Basically I've made it 1.5x bigger and added lots of new areas and 3 huge cranes you can climb. I'm super proud of it so check it out!

[h1]Reworked Movement[/h1]
If you liked the new movement, you'll LOVE the new movement. There's 2 general changes in the way the movement works.

[b]1. Added momentum[/b]
Now every action you take, like dashing, grappling, using speed boosts/ramps builds momentum. Basically what this means is you can keep your super fast speed for a while instead of it instantly going away.
Momentum is also used in slides now so your slide speed is based on how fast you were going before.

[b]2. Reworked the abilities[/b]
[list]
[*]Buffed the dash duration and made it more consistent
[*]Completely overhauled the grapple hook. It's now a swing instead of pulling you towards a target (you can still grapple to the roof– use it to build momentum). This differentiates it from jetpack more. 
[*]The jetpack now slowly builds up speed instead of instantly making you fly. This means that if you're falling and you use it it will take a while to break your fall. Also if you use it long enough you can fly really fast up.
 [*]Buffed jetpack duration 5s —> 15s
[/list]

[h1]Fixed Coin Purchasing[/h1]
Buying coins has been broken for the past few updates—I've finally gotten around to fixing it.

So uh yeah- I can finally make money from Paint Warfare xD
Coins are also super cheap now :)

notes.content:
[h1]New Menu[/h1]
The Paint Warfare Menu hasn't changed much since the game released into early access in 2019. It had a lot of issues—like for example it wasn't clear to new users how to equip/unlock different guns and abilities.

So I've spent a lot of time redesigning and organising everything better:

Play Capture the Flag on two sides of the same castle! There's huge verticality, bridges, hideouts, and parts of some towers are even enterable!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/6834a2dcf97106fea5e19be280b453ab3155a61f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/46222f43a896f033e93ee3280c376060b2e08bc4.png[/img]
This is a new always active passive ability
[list]
[*]The first bullet of the mag deals 1.5X damage. For example, the damage for the AK is something like [48, 23, 23, 23 etc]. For the shotgun pistol, one of the pellets is randomly chosen to do 1.5X damage
[*]Overall it's a pretty unique ability, there will be more abilities soon that modify game rules or centre around combat rather than movement. Let me know on the [url=https://discord.gg/paint-warfare-515461022677729292]Paint Warfare Discord[/url] if you have ideas!

[h3]Med Kit[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/a4cf14d1c15e74bcbc6702eba434fbfe814907cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/a1ac9d5df85d5ea45d35faf0b18de6279a27950c.gif[/img]

[*]This replaces the old 'Heal' ability with something that's also useful for cooperation team-based modes. If you bought the old heal ability, you'll have this automatically unlocked

[*]So essentially if you see one of your allies are low, you can throw the medkit at them and heal them :)

[*]Buffed the overall speed of the glider
[*]Added wind SFX depending on the speed, and the camera now zooms slightly depending on how fast you're going
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/a5836b250491df9b4e0d5537ca24398a6776a34b.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Overhauled: Radar[/h3]
[list]
[*]The radar was very weak, so now on top of showing enemies through walls, it now displays directional arrows around your crosshair to reveal nearby enemies to you
[/list]

[h3]Overhauled: Super Speed Boots[/h3]
[list]
[*]Super speed boots now increase speed while midair as well
[/list]

This was the suggestion of some of the members on our community [url=https://discord.gg/paint-warfare-515461022677729292]Paint Warfare Discord Server[/url]. I've only added it to the new castle map for the time being.

[*]The more bases you hold, the more points you gain. If the enemy even partially tries to uncapture your base, you stop getting points from it

[h3]PRESSURE WASHER[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/e76246d85b58a6b7725ad3896f2ffa292e501622.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/468014b84fe394a7fa285d8bcafeb96a28b3cfb6.png[/img]This one's been really well requested... it shoots in bursts of 2 and deals very heavy and accurate damage (but is a bit slow)

[h3]STICKY MINE LAUNCHER[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/fa024a2e99659937b718ff2324e7a5dbfb20ae5a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/9cd7aa0fef576a709036d7186868c995389a213a.png[/img]A few updates back when I was adding the teleporter, I was playing around with the idea of a mine launcher. I really liked the idea, so this update I'm introducing the mine gun!

[*]6 mine barrel
[*]Mines stick to walls or other players
[*]Explode after 1s
[*]Excellent in tight spaces
[/list]

[h3]AK IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/5ac88a6556a556ce6862a7725b7e5002277092d5.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/4012ac23a2784e5da349dd3eee2c632a05d9094d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/982b195a17074e779863061236434f5c886f8243.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/9de9d5c81150a12707ae26c9875a0051cdf7c53b.png[/img]
The current version of the gas gun wasn't true to my original vision for the gun, or to how you guys probably expected it to work.
It only did damage in a straight line and was really inaccurate. So to make it feel more like 'gas', I've made some improvements.
[list]
[*]It now damages over an area (sort of like a shotgun)
[*]I've buffed the damages over distance, though it still will do most damage when you're close to the enemy
[/list]

[h3]WEAPON REBALANCING[/h3]
[list]
[*]It felt like you died too fast, so I've rebalanced all the weapons so you effectively have ~ 2x more health
[*]I also noticed that you'd get shot a lot from behind (which isn't fun), so I made some improvements to make it clearer when you get hurt (see: Polish and bug fix below)
[/list]


[h1](2.) RANKING CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*]You'll now rank up faster, added 3 more ranks
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/04b565c52e9d0d9fd290160965338513c6f7d450.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/3161c582837103d5b2b03c7aa1d9b2d3188160b4.png[/img]

[*]Theres now two ability classes: passive and active
[*]Active abilities are those that recharge on kills, such as the dash, turret or invisibility, and passive abilities are ones that are always charged, like the jetpack, grapple hook, speed boots etc.
[*]You'll now be able to equip both at once, which should allow for more combinations and even better movement
[/list]

[list]

[*]You can fall to the ground faster by holding your slide key (ctrl)
[/list]

notes.title: Paint Warfare Back On Steam! (Public Beta 0.6.0_b Released)
notes.content:
[i]The goal of the Paint Warfare rework was to fix a lot of the underlying issues with the old Paint Warfare and to shape the game into something that was unique to anything any other FPS game has to offer currently

After a bunch of closed testing, and a short public beta on itch.io, Paint Warfare is back on Steam! :)
[/i]

[h2]Combat Changes:[/h2]
The old Paint Warfare combat was really slow and unoriginal.

Now, nearly every single mechanic encourages incredibly fast-paced play and rushing in on your opponents

[i]My favourite mechanic is the health "stealing" which rewards you health for kills and replaces the old auth health regen that encouraged people to hide away once losing health. This mechanic makes it so satisfying to clutch kills on low health
[/i]
[h3]Other cool mechanics that I won't go into:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Respawn invulnerability (rush opponents/revenge)
[*] Grenade jumping (difficult to pull of but incredibly fun lol)
[*] Faster time to kills
[*] Removal of terrible mechanics that encouraged the opposite of what I'm trying to achieve xD
[/list]

This overall makes the game feel so incredibly unique.


[h2]Better Maps:[/h2]
The new maps are better designed than the old Paint Warfare's offerings. They offer more cover around the map, and places to shelter against people grenade jumping and turning into an "areal strike unit" — (yes that's a thing). 
[i]Anyways, although there are only 2 right now, there are more coming..[/i]


[h2]Polish and Less Bugs:[/h2]
[i]Do I need to say more?[/i]


Anyways I really hope you guys enjoy the rerelease! So far the feedback from you guys has been really incredible, so thanks for sticking around :)

notes.title: Paint Warfare 1.8 Gameplay and Polish Overhaul
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/79d931fe109decccd4353930ea1d3a4b28ec6464.png[/img]

After a month of both open and closed beta testing on the discord server, we’ve nailed down most of the major bugs found in 1.7 and 1.7.2. Along with that, some well-needed overhauls reworks, and polish work have finally been completed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/c73177446804b5e4e80db7d3f4e10c6d2c62ce33.png[/img]

[h1]Maps:[/h1]
The older 3x3km blizzard and archipelago maps have been completely replaced with new closer range Dunes and Mudslide maps!
The main reason we have decided to put forward this change was simply due to the large amount of distance needed to be covered by foot with the removal of vehicles from the game.
These new maps provide unique gameplay possibilities; the Dunes map is more open while the Mudslide map is filled with cover.

Further, minor changes have been made to the Factory and Wetlands maps to provide more cover.

[h1]Movement:[/h1]
1.8 provides much more responsive and faster paced movement, with more polish given to the B-hopping (bunny hopping), Grenade jumping and climbing mechanics in the game. Air control has also been added which allows the player some control when jumping.

[h1]Combat:[/h1]
The combat systems from 1.7 have been completely overhauled with the 1.8 update.

One of the main issues that our players found with combat pre 1.7 was how the game punished the player when being low on health. This has now been removed with the damaged effect now being more subtle.
Further, auto-health regeneration has been put into place, though as to not render the med-kit useless with this mechanic, the regeneration lacks the ability to regenerate shield, and the med-kit now has a shorter cool down.

In order to make combat more interesting, the bazooka will now be able to damage the player if used at too close of a range. This is both in part to balance the bazooka and encourage the use of secondary or primary weapons at these ranges.

Bugs with the crosshair have also now been fixed, and you are now also able to hold grenades in your hand and only throw it when you let go of the mouse.

New SFX have also been introduced for the weapons to better fit a paintball theme.

[h1]Matchmaking, AI and Spectator:[/h1]
Seperate buttons have been added for each map in order to make it easier to join a preferred room. Further, rooms are now capped at 8 players, and should extra players join, they would be sent to another room.

To assist with a lack of players at times, a basic AI has been added while a player is waiting for other players to join a room. This will encourage players to wait for others to join rather than quitting the game.
This AI will not damage the players, but will earn the player XP when killed.

A new spectator mode has been added and the ability to hide UI in game has been added to assist people who would like to record gameplay without UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/d2eb8b5dc48fa55eeedcc469aaea49dd3be8bada.png[/img]

[h1]Other major changes:[/h1]
[h3]Environment:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Environment particles
[*] Added unique reverb presets to each map
[*] Added lens flare to sunny maps
[/list]
[h3]Movement:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added ability to step up on platforms
[*] Removed vehicles
[*] Fixed flying ragdolls
[/list]
[h3]Weapons:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed Uzi
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented bazookas and grenades from dealing damage
[*] Increased grenade jump force
[/list]
[h3]UI:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Brand new menu UIs
[*] Removed redundant parts of old menus
[/list]
[h3]Other:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved chat moderation system
[*] Shortened the launching sequence
[*] New preloader
[/list]

notes.title: Paint Warfare 1.7.0 : New maps, planes, grenades and more!
notes.content:
Paint Warfare 1.7.0 has been a trek; it's been a 3-month project, the most development time ever put into a release after 1.0. 
[b]We've had countless new people come and go, helping make this update possible, and I'm finally happy to announce that the 1.7.0 update is now public on Steam![/b]
[previewyoutube=jYSWUjsloQw;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Movement:[/h2]
Movement has been overhauled, it's now much smoother and more responsive. Crouching bugs have been patched and animations have been overhauled, and network usage has been optimised 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/9c5d82b6f8e8ebb3c1c4f08a59893d34b155e82d.png[/img]
[h2]Maps:[/h2]
The old 2x2km Tornado and Blizzard maps have been completely replaced with 2 completely new 3x3km maps fit-out with trucks and fighter planes. The new maps also feature a spawn select, so you can tactically choose your favourite spawn and get right into the action.

An LMS mode has also been introduced into the factory map, along with various optimisation and lighting changes
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/2ab22d8d4bd5ee4955d08dc649988fa0ceee419a.png[/img]

An entire new weapon class has also been introduced, with 4 new grenade types now in the game. Med-kits have received a massive buff, and a new auto-heal timer has now been introduced, so you will automatically regenerate health after not taking damage for a few seconds.

Grenade jumping has also been added, along with a void, so you don't fly too high. 
All bugs with the old team deathmatch system have been fixed, and nametags have been removed in FFA.

Paint splatters and bullet delays have now also been added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/1244e3044c3595a529c7aeaa47d87b3f1cc49db5.png[/img]
[h2]UIs and Menus:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/6078457787b9a92c2ad8b550e3af3ea52daf10e6.png[/img]

[*]Impoved the chat censoring system to minimise false blocking
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented tanks from shooting

notes.title: Paint Warfare - Steam Release! Version 6.0
notes.content:
Paint Warfare is a low-poly casual multiplayer FPS with large scale maps. team and FFA combat, fun and unique weapons, vehicles and much more!

[h1]Features of this update:[/h1]
6.0 brings many massive improvements and features to the table, including vehicles, unique secondary weapons, and a brand new 2x2km tornado map!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177508/40fe0c34edab2b02ec4528ea936c4db0ce12fb3b.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Ground and water vehicles unique to each map. Wetlands features RHIBs and both the Blizzard and Tornado maps focus on tanks, trucks and armoured cars
[*] New cutscenes! The Tornado and Wetlands map now have an epic animation when spawning
[*] New tornado map! Cooked up a fresh new map with brand new models and textures, just make sure to not get sucked in!
[*] Crouching! You asked, we listened. You can now crouch to get into those tiny spaces and buildings
